description: Imports and Exports Control Department - Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 05 of 2022
categorisation: This gazette content promulgates new regulations under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969, as amended. It establishes legal requirements for import licenses for specific goods and amends existing regulations. While it mentions Basil Rajapaksa as Minister of Finance, this is only in the context of exercising statutory powers to create these regulations, not to detail his portfolio responsibilities. The core content is purely regulatory, focusing on import control mechanisms and legal compliance requirements, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
